summary: CASI Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of the fourth and final tranche of a US$20 million convertible note financing with ETP Global III Fund LP. A US$5 million note was issued, maturing in 36 months at 12% interest. The note is convertible into ordinary shares at the volume-weighted average closing price over the five trading days before maturity or conversion, with a floor of US$1 and cap of US$2 per share. This is a routine financing disclosure under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation event. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The filing is procedural and does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring; watch for potential dilution upon conversion.
